remarks:
Welcome to your happy place in the heart of the village! If you've been searching for a home with warmth, character, and timeless charm, this inviting 3-bedroom home is ready to welcome you.

Step inside and you'll immediately appreciate the gorgeous wide-plank wood floors, beautiful natural light, and the thoughtful built-in cabinetry that adds both beauty and function throughout the dining room, kitchen, and bathroom. Every room offers a sense of comfort that makes this house feel like home.

Picture yourself starting the day with a cup of coffee in the cozy bay window as the morning sun pours in and songbirds visit the yard. The spacious kitchen offers plenty of room to add an island, breakfast nook, or additional workspace, making it equally suited for everyday living or gathering with family and friends.

The flexible floor plan includes two comfortable living spaces, giving you endless possibilities for a home office, playroom, hobby room, formal living room, or even a potential first-floor bedroom. First-floor laundry adds everyday convenience, while the first-floor furnace and water heater help protect these major mechanicals from basement moisture, contributing to their long-term performance.

Outside, you'll find even more to love. Relax on the covered front porch, host summer cookouts on the large rear deck, or enjoy the spacious backyard with room for gardening, pets, entertaining, or simply unwinding after a long day. A storage shed keeps lawn equipment and seasonal items neatly organized, while the surprisingly dry crawl-space basement provides additional storage for totes, holiday decorations, and more.

Located just a short walk from the village park, this home offers the perfect balance of small-town charm and everyday convenience. You're only 3 minutes from Kanakadea Park and just 5 minutes from shopping, restaurants, and amenities in Hornell.

Homes with this much character, flexibility, and charm don't come along often. Come see for yourself why this could be the perfect place to call home.
